source: Given an input that changes over time, Temporal Smoothing will provide an average of each point and cell data values over a temporal window centered on a requested time step. Because of this, the input's topology is assumed to not change over time, and so the number and order of its points and cells should stay the same. In order to provide comparable results for different time steps, the temporal window must be the same size. To enforce this the filter clips its input available time steps to allow the full window size to fit. If an out-of-bound time step is requested, the filter will use the closest available time step. Note that updating this filter will trigger upstream updates for each time steps of the window, which could be expensive.
translation: 鉴于一个随时间而变化的输入,Tempolar Slipping将在一个以请求的时间步骤为中心的时间窗口上提供每个点和单元格数据值的平均值. 由于这个原因,输入的地形假设不会随时间变化,因此其积分和单元格的数量和顺序应该保持不变. 为了提供不同时间步骤的可比结果,时间窗口必须相同大小. 要执行此功能, 过滤器会剪辑其可用的输入时间步骤, 以适应整个窗口大小 。 如果请求一个出界时间步骤,过滤器将使用最接近可用的时间步骤. 请注意,更新此过滤器将触发窗口每个时间步骤的上游更新,费用可能很高.

source: The Exodus reader loads Exodus II files and produces an unstructured grid output. The default file extensions are .g, .e, .ex2, .ex2v2, .exo, .gen, .exoII, .exii, .frq, .0, .00, .000, and .0000. The file format is described fully at: http://endo.sandia.gov/SEACAS/Documentation/exodusII.pdf. Each Exodus file contains a single set of points with 2-D or 3-D coordinates plus one or more blocks, sets, and maps. Block group elements (or their bounding edges or faces) of the same type together. Sets select subsets (across all the blocks in a file) of elements, sides of elements (which may be of mixed dimensionality), bounding faces of volumetric elements, or bounding edges of volumetric or areal elements. Each block or set may have multiple result variables, each of which defines a value per element, per timestep. The elements (cells), faces of elements (when enumerated in face blocks), edges of elements (when enumerated in edge blocks), and nodes (points) in a file may be assigned an arbitrary integer number by an element map, face map, edge map, or node map, respectively. Usually, only a single map of each type exists and is employed to assign a unique global ID to entities across multiple files which partition a large mesh for a distributed-memory calculation. However here may be multiply maps of each type and there are no constraints which force the integers to be unique. The connectivity of elements is constant across all of the timesteps in any single Exodus II file. However, multiple files which specify a single time-evolution of a mesh may be used to represent meshes which exhibit changes in connectivity infrequently. Field variable mode_shape[0] represents the time step (t_index) if HasModeShapes is not set or the ModeShape otherwise. This is a distributed reader.
translation: Exodus阅读器加载Exodus II文件并产生无结构的网格输出. 默认文件扩展名有:.g,.e,.ex2,.ex2v2,.exo,.gen,.exoII,.exii,.frq,0,.00,000,和.000. 文件格式在http://endo.sandia.gov/SEACAS/Documentation/exodusII.pdf中作了全面描述。 每个Exodus文件包含一组单一的点,带有2-D或3-D坐标加上一个或多个块,集,和地图. 类同的块状元素(或其边缘或面)一起. 设定选择元素的子集(在文件中的所有块之间),元素的侧面(可能是混合维度),量子元素的边框,或者量子元素或质子元素的边框. 每个块或组合可能具有多个结果变量,每个变量都定义每个元素的值,每个时间步. 元素(单元格),元素的面部(当在面块中列出时),元素的边缘(当在边缘块中列出时),和一个文件中的节点(点),可以被元素图,面图,边缘图,或节点图分别指定任意的整数. 通常,每个类型都只有一个地图,用来为多个文件的实体分配一个独特的全球ID,这些实体将一个大网格分割出来,用于分布式计算。 然而,这里可能包含每种类型的乘法地图,没有限制迫使整数是独一无二的。 元素的互联互通在任何单一的Exodus II文件中贯穿所有的时间段都是恒定的. 然而,可使用多个文件来指定网格的单一时间演变,以代表互联互通不经常出现变化的网格。 字段变量模式 形状[0] 表示如果 HasMode 形状没有设置或者模式形状没有设置时步(t index) 。 这是一个分布式的读者。

source: Computes the shortest path on the input mesh. The output is a polyline representing the geodesic path between the selected start and end point (or cell). The path can depend on a given scalar field. On distributed data, the path will be computed independently on each node.

source: The Material Interface filter finds voxels inside of which a material fraction (or normalized amount of material) is higher than a given threshold. As these voxels are identified surfaces enclosing adjacent voxels above the threshold are generated. The resulting volume and its surface are what we call a fragment. The filter has the ability to compute various volumetric attributes such as fragment volume, mass, center of mass as well as volume and mass weighted averages for any of the fields present. Any field selected for such computation will be also be copied into the fragment surface's point data for visualization. The filter also has the ability to generate Oriented Bounding Boxes (OBB) for each fragment. The data generated by the filter is organized in three outputs. The \"geometry\" output, containing the fragment surfaces. The \"statistics\" output, containing a point set of the centers of mass. The \"obb representation\" output, containing OBB representations (poly data). All computed attributes are copied into the statistics and geometry output. The obb representation output is used for validation and debugging purposes and is turned off by default. To measure the size of craters, the filter can invert a volume fraction and clip the volume fraction with a sphere and/or a plane.
translation: 材料接口过滤器在其中发现一个材料分量(或材料的正常量)高于给定阈值的Voxels. 由于这些阴道被识别为附着在阈值之上的相邻阴道的表面,所以产生. 所产生的体积及其表面就是我们所说的碎片。 滤波器具有计算各种体积属性的能力,如碎片体积、质量、质量中心以及所存在的任何字段的体积和质量加权平均值。 为这种计算选择的任何字段也将被复制到碎片表面的点数据中,以便可视化. 滤波器还具有为每个片段生成Oriented Bonding Boxes(OBB)的能力. 过滤器生成的数据分为三个产出。 \"几何\"输出,包含碎片表面. \“统计”输出,包含质量中心的点集。 \"obb 表示\"输出,包含OBB表示(poly data). 所有计算属性都被复制到统计和几何输出中。 obb 表示输出用于校验和调试目的,默认关闭. 为了测量陨坑的大小,过滤器可以反转一个容积分数,用球体和/或平面来剪切容积分数.

translation: 表面矢量过滤器用于2D数据集. 它通过将正常的矢量的成分移到局部表面来限制矢量沉降在表面.

source: This property specifies whether the vectors will be parallel or perpendicular to the surface. If the value is set to PerpendicularScale (2), then the output will contain a scalar array with the dot product of the surface normal and the vector at each point.
translation: 此属性指定矢量是平行的还是与表面垂直的 。 如果将值设定为Perpondicular Scale (2),则输出将包含一个带有表面正常和矢量每个点的点产物的scalar阵列.

source: PointSetToOctreeImage can be used to convert a point set to an image with a number of points per cell target and an unsigned char octree cell array. Each bit of the unsigned char indicates if the point-set had a point close to one of the 8 corners of the cell. It can optionally also output a cell array based on an input point array. This array will have 1 or many components that represent different functions i.e. last value, min, max, count, sum, mean.
translation: PointSetToctreeImage可以用来将一个点集转换成一个图像,每个单元格目标有多个点,和一个没有符号的Char octree单元格阵列. 未签名字符的每个位表示点集是否有靠近单元格8角之一的点. 它也可以根据输入点阵列可选择输出一个单元格数组. 此数组将有代表不同函数的1个或许多组件,即最后一个值,分钟,最大值,计数,总和,平均值.

source: The Fast Uniform Grid source can be used to create a uniform grid with scalar values derived from relatively light computations. The active scalar array is named \"X\", and is set to the X coordinate for each pixel. There are two additional point data sets. The data array named \"DistanceSquared\" is computed as the squared distance from each pixel to the origin. The data array named \"Swirl\" is a vector field computed as (Y,Z,X) at each pixel.
translation: 快速统一网格源可以用来创建一个具有相对轻度计算得出的scalar值的统一网格. 活动的scalar阵列命名为\"\",并设定为每个像素的X坐标. 另有两个点数据集. 名为 \“ DistanceSquared\ ” 的数据阵列是按从每个像素到来源的平方距离计算的 。 名为 \“ swirl\” 的数据阵列是一个向量字段, 在每个像素上计算为( Y, Z, X) 。

source: Enable/disable DistanceSquared point data scalar array.
translation: 启用/ 禁用距离方位数据分级阵列 。

source: This defines the interface for the parallel writers.
translation: 这定义了并行作者的界面.

source: The number of ghost levels to include in the output file(s). Note that some writers (such as ExodusIIWriter and CGNSWriter) may not support writing ghost levels.
translation: 输出文件中要包含的幽灵关卡数 。 注意一些作者(如ExodusIIWriter和CGNSWriter)可能不支持写鬼关.

source: When WriteTimeSteps is OFF, the writer writes only the current timestep. Otherwise it is called once for each time step within the min and max range. If those are not set, the writer is called for all time steps available in its input.
translation: 当 WriteTimeSteps 关闭时, 作者只写当前的时间步 。 否则,在分钟和最大范围内每一步使用一次。 如果这些没有设定,则要求作者在其投入中采取所有可用的时间步骤。

source: The values in this property specify a list of current offset values. This can be used to create multiple slices with different centers. Each entry represents a new slice with its center shifted by the offset value.
translation: 此属性中的值指定了当前抵消值列表 。 这可用于创建多个具有不同中心的切片. 每个条目代表一个新的切片,其中心被抵消值所转移.

source: The Elevation filter generates point scalar values for an input dataset along a specified direction vector. The Input menu allows the user to select the data set to which this filter will be applied. Use the Scalar range entry boxes to specify the minimum and maximum scalar value to be generated. The Low Point and High Point define a line onto which each point of the data set is projected. The minimum scalar value is associated with the Low Point, and the maximum scalar value is associated with the High Point. The scalar value for each point in the data set is determined by the location along the line to which that point projects.
translation: Elevation 过滤器会沿着指定的方向向量生成输入数据集的点刻度值. 输入菜单允许用户选择将应用此过滤器的数据集. 使用 Scalar 范围条目框来指定要生成的最小和最大比例值 。 低点和高点定义了数据集每个点的预测线. 最低scalar值与低点相关,最高scalar值与高点相关. 数据集中每个点的刻度值由该点项目所在线上的位置决定.

source: Create a point array representing elevation.
translation: 创建代表海拔的点数组 。

source: This property determines the range into which scalars will be mapped.
translation: 此属性决定了将映射到的刻度范围 。

source: If the value of this property is set to 1, then the extracted edges are assigned a scalar value based on the type of the edge.
translation: 如果将这个属性的值设定为1,那么所提取的边缘会根据边缘的类型分配一个刻度值.

source: The value of this property is used to define a feature edge. If the surface normal between two adjacent triangles is at least as large as this Feature Angle, a feature edge exists. (See the FeatureEdges property.)
translation: 此属性的值用于定义特征边缘 。 如果两个相邻三角之间表面的正常程度至少与这个地物角一样大,则存在一个地物边缘. (参见地物Edges属性.

source: The Threshold filter extracts the portions of the input dataset whose scalars lie within the specified range. This filter operates on either point-centered or cell-centered data. It operates on any type of dataset and produces unstructured grid output. The scalar array from which to threshold the data can be selected in the 'Scalars' menu. For a multi-components array, 'Selected Component' menu allows you to select a specific component or magnitude if using the 'Selected' component mode. You can also choose 'All' or 'Any' that will keep data if either all components or at least one satisfies the threshold. Note that multi-components arrays are not available with Hyper Tree Grid inputs. The 'Lower Threshold' and 'Upper Threshold' sliders determine the range of the scalars to retain in the output. The threshold method can be selected from the 'Threshold Method' menu. The 'All Scalars' option only applies to Point Data. When this option is on, a cell will only be passed to the output if the scalar values of all of its points lie within the chosen range. When off, a cell will be added to the output if the specified scalar value for any of its points is within the chosen range.
translation: 阈值过滤器提取输入数据集中其分级位于指定范围内的部分。 此过滤器在以点为中心的数据或以单元格为中心的数据上运行。 它在任何类型的数据集上运行,并产生无结构的网格输出. 在“ Scalars” 菜单中可以选择用于阈值的数据的scalar 数组 。 对于一个多组件阵列,“选定组件”菜单允许您使用“选定”组件模式选择特定的组件或尺寸。 您也可以选择“ 全部” 或“ 任何” 来保存数据, 如果所有组件或至少一个组件都满足阈值的话 。 注意多元件阵列无法使用 Hyper Tree Grid 输入 。 “ 下阈值” 和“ 上阈值” 滑动器决定输出中要保留的刻度范围 。 阈值方法可以从“危险方法”菜单中选择。 All Scalars 选项仅适用于点数据 。 当此选项打开时, 只有其所有点的刻度值位于所选范围内时, 单元格才会传递给输出 。 关闭时,如果单元格中任一点的指定刻度值在选定的范围内,则单元格将被添加到输出中。

source: Select how to construct the result in memory: - MaskInput (default): shallow copy the input and mask all cells being thresholded - Regenerate Trees And Index Fields: generate a new tree structure but use indexed arrays on the input for cell data - New HyperTreeGrid: construct a new HyperTreeGrid from scratch representing the minimal threshold of the input
translation: 选择如何在内存中构造结果 : - MaskInput( 默认): 浅复制输入并遮盖所有被阈值的单元格 - 重新生成树和索引字段: 生成一个新的树状结构,但在输入的单元格数据上使用索引数组 - New HyperTreeGrid: 从零开始构建一个新的HyperTreeGrid, 代表输入的最低阈值

source: This filter generates surface tangents at the points of the input polygonal dataset based on the normals and the texture coordinates. The resulting dataset is also polygonal. The tangents are required when using a normal texture.
translation: 这种滤波器在输入多边形数据集的点上根据正常和纹理坐标生成表面正切. 由此产生的数据集也是多边形的. 使用正常纹理时需要切合剂.

source: This filter will produce surface tangents used for normal mapping.
translation: 这个过滤器将产生用于正常映射的表面正切剂.

source: The Quadric Clustering filter produces a reduced-resolution polygonal approximation of the input polygonal dataset. This filter is the one used by ParaView for computing LODs. It uses spatial binning to reduce the number of points in the data set; points that lie within the same spatial bin are collapsed into one representative point.
translation: 四方集群滤波器产生输入多边形数据集的减分辨率多边形近似. 这个过滤器是ParaView用来计算LOD的. 它使用空间binning来减少数据集中的点数;位于同一个空间bin内的点被崩溃成一个代表点.

source: If the value of this property is set to 1, the representative point for each bin is selected from one of the input points that lies in that bin; the input point that produces the least error is chosen. If the value of this property is 0, the location of the representative point is calculated to produce the least error possible for that bin, but the point will most likely not be one of the input points.
translation: 如果此属性的值设置为 1, 则从该 bin 中的输入点中选择每个 bin 的代表点; 选择产生最小错误的输入点 。 如果这个属性的值是0,则代表点的位置被计算出来,以产生该 bin 可能最小的错误,但该点很可能不会是输入点之一.

source: Flag controls whether to reverse normal orientation.
translation: 旗帜控制是否逆向正常方向.

source: This property determines whether input scalars or computed eigenvalues at the point should be used to color the glyphs. If ThreeGlyphs is set and the eigenvalues are chosen for coloring then each glyph is colored by the corresponding eigenvalue and if not set the color corresponding to the largest eigenvalue is chosen.
translation: 此属性决定是输入刻度还是计算出点上的 eigen 值来给刻度配色 。 如果设定了3Glyphs,选择了eigen值来进行配色,那么每个glyph就按照相应的eigen值来配色,如果不设定与最大eigen值对应的颜色则选择.

source: Use Default Normal
translation: 使用默认正常

source: If this property is set to 0, and the input contains no vector array, then default ribbon normals will be generated (DefaultNormal property); if a vector array has been set (SelectInputVectors property), the ribbon normals will be set from the specified array. If this property is set to 1, the default normal (DefaultNormal property) will be used, regardless of whether the SelectInputVectors property has been set.
translation: 如果将这个属性设定为 0, 而输入中没有向量数组, 那么默认的丝带正常会生成( 默认的自然属性 ); 如果设置了向量数组( 选择输入器属性) , 则从指定的数组中设定丝带正常 。 如果将此属性设定为 1, 则将使用默认的普通属性( 默认非正常属性) , 不论是否设定了 SelectInputVector 属性 。

source: Default Normal
translation: 默认正常

source: The value of this property specifies the normal to use when the UseDefaultNormal property is set to 1 or the input contains no vector array (SelectInputVectors property).
translation: 此属性的值指定了当使用DefaultNormal属性被设定为1或输入中未包含矢量数组(SelectInputVectors property)时要使用的正常值.

source: vtkDataObjectGenerator parses a string and produces dataobjects from the dataobject template names it sees in the string. For example, if the string contains \"ID1\" the generator will create a vtkImageData. \"UF1\", \"RG1\", \"SG1\", \"PD1\", and \"UG1\" will produce vtkUniformGrid, vtkRectilinearGrid, vtkStructuredGrid, vtkPolyData and vtkUnstructuredGrid respectively. \"PD2\" will produce an alternate vtkPolyData. You can compose composite datasets from the atomic ones listed above - \"MB{}\" or \"HB[]\". \"MB{ ID1 PD1 MB{} }\" for example will create a vtkMultiBlockDataSet consisting of three blocks: image data, poly data, multiblock (empty). Hierarchical Box data sets additionally require the notion of groups, declared within \"()\" braces, to specify AMR depth. \"HB[ (UF1)(UF1)(UF1) ]\" will create a vtkHierarchicalBoxDataSet representing an octree that is three levels deep, in which the first cell in each level is refined.
translation: vtkData ObjectGenerator 解析一个字符串,并从它在字符串中看到的数据对象模板名称中生成数据对象. 例如,如果字符串包含\"ID1\",生成器会创建一个vtkImageData. \"UF1\",\"RG1\",\"SG1\","PD1\",和\"UG1\"将分别产生vtkUniformGrid,vtkRectilinearGrid,vtkStructuredGrid,vtkPolyData和vtkUnstructuredGrid. \"PD2\"将生成一个替代 vtkPolyData. 您可以从上面列出的原子中编译复合数据集 -\"MBQ"或\"HB[]\". \"MB{ ID1 PD1 MB{}}\" 例如将创建一个vtk MultiBlockDataSet,由三个块组成:图像数据,多数据,多块(空). 等级框数据集额外要求组合的概念,在\()\()\)括号内声明,以指定AMR深度.\" HB [(UF1)(UF1)(UF1)]\"将创建一个 vtkHierchical BoxDataSet,代表一个三层深的八角树,其中每个级别的第一个单元格被精炼.

translation: 利用主要组件分析估计正常情况。

translation: 此属性指定用于估算正常值的输入 。

source: Normal Orientation

source: Point used to orient the normals.
translation: 点用来引导正常人

source: This filter generates evenly spaced streamlines in a 2D vector field from a start position. Production of streamlines terminates if a streamline crosses the exterior boundary of the input dataset (ReasonForTermination=1), an initialization issue (ReasonForTermination=2), computing an unexpected value (ReasonForTermination=3), reached the Maximum Streamline Length input value (ReasonForTermination=4), reached the Maximum Steps input value (ReasonForTermination=5), velocity was lower than the Terminal Speed input value (ReasonForTermination=6), a streamline formed a loop (ReasonForTermination=7), and the streamline was too close to other streamlines (ReasonForTermination=8). This filter operates on a 2D dataset aligned with plane XY with point-centered vectors aligned with plane XY. The output is polygonal data containing polylines.
translation: 此过滤器从起始位置生成2D矢量字段的均匀空间精简 。 如果精简跨越输入数据集的外部边界(ReasonForTermination=1),则精简终止;初始化问题(ReasonForTermination=2),计算出意料值(ReasonForTermination=3),达到最大精简长度输入值(ReasonForTermination=4),达到最大步骤输入值(ReasonFerTermination=5),速度低于终端速度输入值(ReasonFerTermination=6),精简形成一个循环(ReasonFerTermination=7),精简过于接近其他精简(ReasonFerTermination=8). 此过滤器在与平面XY对齐的2D数据集上运行,与平面XY对齐的以点为中心的向量. 输出是包含多线的多边形数据.

translation: 在一个2D向量字段中产生均匀的空间精简。

translation: 此属性包含用于生成精简的矢量数组的名称 。

translation: 此属性决定了用于创建精简的集成器( 精度越来越高) 。

source: This property specifies the maximum number of steps, beyond which streamline integration is terminated.
translation: 此属性指定了步骤的最大数量,除此之外将终止精简整合。

source: Specify the separating distance between streamlines expressed in IntegrationStepUnit.
translation: 指定集成单元中表达的精简之间的分隔距离。

source: Specifies SeparatingDistanceRatio. If streamlines get closer than SeparatingDistance * SeparatingDistanceRatio to other streamlines integration stops.

Production of streamlines terminates if a streamline crosses the exterior boundary of the input dataset (ReasonForTermination=1). Other reasons for termination include an initialization issue (ReasonForTermination=2), computing an unexpected value (ReasonForTermination=3), reached the Maximum Streamline Length input value (ReasonForTermination=4), reached the Maximum Steps input value (ReasonForTermination=5), and velocity was lower than the Terminal Speed input value (ReasonForTermination=6). This filter operates on any type of dataset, provided it has point-centered vectors. The output is polygonal data containing polylines.
translation: Stream Tracer 过滤器从种子点集合中生成一个矢量字段的精简. 如果精简跨越输入数据集的外部边界(ReasonForTermination=1),则制作精简终止. 终止的其他原因包括初始化问题(ReasonForTermination=2),计算出意料值(ReasonForTermination=3),达到最大精简长度输入值(ReasonFertermination=4),达到最大步骤输入值(ReasonFertermination=5),速度低于终端速度输入值(ReasonForTermination=6). 这个过滤器在任何类型的数据集上运行,前提是它具有以点为中心的向量. 输出是包含多线的多边形数据.

translation: 表面精简

translation: 此属性指定了最大精简长度(即物理弧长度),超过此长度的线条集成终止.

source: This property specifies the maximum error (for Runge-Kutta 4-5) tolerated throughout streamline integration. The Runge-Kutta 4-5 integrator tries to adjust the step size such that the estimated error is less than this threshold.
translation: 此属性指定了整个精简整合过程中允许的最大错误( 对于 Runge- Kutta 4-5) 。 Runge-Kutta 4-5集成器试图调整步骤大小,使估计误差小于此阈值.

source: The value of this property determines how the seeds for the streamlines will be generated.
translation: 此属性的价值决定了如何生成精简的种子 。

source: The Stream Tracer With Custom Source filter generates streamlines in a vector field from a collection of seed points. Production of streamlines terminates if a streamline crosses the exterior boundary of the input dataset (ReasonForTermination=1). Other reasons for termination include an initialization issue (ReasonForTermination=2), computing an unexpected value (ReasonForTermination=3), reached the Maximum Streamline Length input value (ReasonForTermination=4), reached the Maximum Steps input value (ReasonForTermination=5), and velocity was lower than the Terminal Speed input value (ReasonForTermination=6). This filter operates on any type of dataset, provided it has point-centered vectors. The output is polygonal data containing polylines. This filter takes a Source input that provides the seed points.
translation: 带有自定义源过滤器的流跟踪器从种子点集合中生成一个矢量字段的精简. 如果精简跨越输入数据集的外部边界(ReasonForTermination=1),则制作精简终止. 终止的其他原因包括初始化问题(ReasonForTermination=2),计算出意料值(ReasonForTermination=3),达到最大精简长度输入值(ReasonFertermination=4),达到最大步骤输入值(ReasonFertermination=5),速度低于终端速度输入值(ReasonForTermination=6). 这个过滤器在任何类型的数据集上运行,前提是它具有以点为中心的向量. 输出是包含多线的多边形数据. 此过滤器需要提供种子点的源输入 。

source: Generate point scalars from level.
translation: 从水平生成点刻度 。

source: vtkCellValidator accepts as input a dataset and adds integral cell data to it corresponding to the validity of each cell. The validity field encodes a bitfield for identifying problems that prevent a cell from standard use, including: WrongNumberOfPoints: filters assume that a cell has access to the appropriate number of points that comprise it. This assumption is often tacit, resulting in unexpected behavior when the condition is not met. This check simply confirms that the cell has the minimum number of points needed to describe it. IntersectingEdges: cells that incorrectly describe the order of their points often manifest with intersecting edges or intersecting faces. Given a tolerance, this check ensures that two edges from a two-dimensional cell are separated by at least the tolerance (discounting end-to-end connections). IntersectingFaces: cells that incorrectly describe the order of their points often manifest with intersecting edges or intersecting faces. Given a tolerance, this check ensures that two faces from a three-dimensional cell do not intersect. NoncontiguousEdges: another symptom of incorrect point ordering within a cell is the presence of noncontiguous edges where contiguous edges are otherwise expected. Given a tolerance, this check ensures that edges around the perimeter of a two-dimensional cell are contiguous. Nonconvex: many algorithms implicitly require that all input three- dimensional cells be convex. This check uses the generic convexity checkers implemented in vtkPolygon and vtkPolyhedron to test this requirement. FacesAreOrientedIncorrectly: All three-dimensional cells have an implicit expectation for the orientation of their faces. While the convention is unfortunately inconsistent across cell types, it is usually required that cell faces point outward. This check tests that the faces of a cell point in the direction required by the cell type, taking into account the cell types with nonstandard orientation requirements.
translation: vtkCellValidator 接受一个数据集作为输入,并在其中添加与每个单元格有效性相对应的完整单元格数据. 有效性字段编码了一个比特字段,用于识别阻碍单元格标准使用的问题,包括: 错误数OfPoints:过滤器假设单元格可以访问构成它的适当数点. 这种假设往往是默认的,导致在条件未得到满足时出现意想不到的行为. 此检查仅确认单元格有描述它所需的最低点数。 交叉Edges:错误地描述其点的顺序的单元格,往往以交叉边或交叉面来表现. 有了容差度,这个检查可以确保从二维单元格中两个边缘至少通过容差度(折扣端到端的连接)来分离. 交叉面(IntersectingFaces):不正确地描述其点的顺序的单元格,常以交叉边或交叉面表现出来. 考虑到容差性,这一检查确保三维单元格中的两个面孔不会交叉. 非毗连Edges:一个单元格内错误点序的另一个症状是存在非毗连的边缘,在其它情况下预计会存在毗连的边缘. 考虑到耐受性,这一检查确保二维单元格周边的边缘是毗连的. 非凸轮:许多算法暗示要求所有输入的三维单元格都是凸轮. 此检查使用 vtkPolygon 和 vtkPolyhedron 中执行的通用对流检查器来测试这一要求. 面向面孔 不正确:所有三维单元格都对面部的定向有隐含的预期. 虽然不幸的是,各单元格类型之间的常规不一致,但通常要求单元格面朝外。 这个检查测试,一个单元格点在单元格类型所需方向上的面部,考虑到具有非标准定向要求的单元格类型.

source: If this property is set to 1, the mean curvature calculation will be inverted. This is useful for meshes with inward-pointing normals.
translation: 如果将此属性设定为 1, 则平均曲率计算将倒转 。 这对有内向指向的正常人来说是有用的。

source: The Level Scalars filter uses colors to show levels of a hierarchical dataset.
translation: Level Scalars过滤器使用颜色来显示分级数据集的级别.

source: Creates polylines representing pathlines of animating particles
translation: 创建代表动画粒子路径的多线

source: If the value of this property is set to 1, coincident vertices will be merged after tessellation has occurred. Only geometry is considered during the merge and the first vertex encountered is the one whose point attributes will be used. Any discontinuities in point fields will be lost. On the other hand, many operations, such as streamline generation, require coincident vertices to be merged. Toggle whether to merge coincident vertices.
translation: 如果此属性的值被设定为 1, 则在细分发生后, 重叠的顶点将被合并 。 合并期间只考虑几何,遇到的第一个顶点是将使用点属性的顶点. 点字段的任何不连续都将消失。 另一方面,许多操作,如精简生成,需要同时的顶点进行合并. 切换是否合并巧合的顶点 。

source: The scalar value at a given point is multiplied by the value of this property to determine the magnitude of the change vector for that point.
translation: 某一点的刻度值乘以此属性的值,以确定该点的变化矢量的大小.

source: Use Normal
translation: 正常使用

source: If the value of this property is 1, then the Z-coordinates from the input are considered to be the scalar values, and the displacement is along the Z axis. This is useful for creating carpet plots.
translation: 如果此属性的值为1,那么输入的Z坐标就被认为是刻度值,而移位则沿着Z轴. 这对创建地毯地块很有用.

source: This filter deflects normal orientation along a vector attribute.
translation: 此过滤器沿向量属性偏移正常方向 。

source: Deflects the normals with a given vector field.
translation: 以给定的矢量字段忽略正常值。

source: Normal deflection factor.
translation: 正常偏移系数。

source: Specify the user constant normal.
translation: 指定用户常数正常。

source: Specify if the output should be normalized. Only used if UseWelchMethod is false.
translation: 指定是否应该使产出正常化。 只有在 UseWelch Method 错误的情况下才使用.

source: Three lines representing the axes - red line along X, green line along Y, and blue line along Z
translation: 代表轴线的三条线——沿X线的红线,沿Y线的绿线,沿Z线的蓝线

source: Create three lines representing X, Y and Z axes
translation: 创建代表 X、 Y 和 Z 轴的三行

source: Filter computing surface normals.
translation: 滤镜计算表面正常。

source: The Generic Clip filter cuts away a portion of the input data set using a plane, a sphere, a box, or a scalar value. The menu in the Clip Function portion of the interface allows the user to select which implicit function to use or whether to clip using a scalar value. Making this selection loads the appropriate user interface. For the implicit functions, the appropriate 3D widget (plane, sphere, or box) is also displayed. The use of these 3D widgets, including their user interface components, is discussed in section 7.4. If an implicit function is selected, the clip filter returns that portion of the input data set that lies inside the function. If Scalars is selected, then the user must specify a scalar array to clip according to. The clip filter will return the portions of the data set whose value in the selected Scalars array is larger than the Clip value. Regardless of the selection from the Clip Function menu, if the Inside Out option is checked, the opposite portions of the data set will be returned. This filter operates on all types of data sets, and it returns unstructured grid data on output.
translation: 通用剪贴过滤器使用平面,球体,框,或刻度值切除一部分输入数据集. 界面的 Clip 函数部分的菜单允许用户选择使用哪个隐含的函数,或者是否使用scalar值进行剪辑. 使此选择加载适当的用户界面 。 对于隐含的函数,也显示相应的3D部件(平面,球体,或框). 第7.4节讨论了这些3D部件的使用,包括其用户界面组件。 如果选中一个隐含的函数,剪辑过滤器会返回位于函数内部的输入数据集的那部分. 如果选中了 Scalars, 那么用户必须指定一个 scalar 阵列来根据它进行剪辑 。 剪辑过滤器将返回所选 Scalars 阵列中值大于 Clip 值的数据集部分 。 无论从 Clip 函数菜单中选择什么,如果选中了内置 Out 选项, 数据集的相反部分会被返回 。 此过滤器在所有类型的数据集上运行,它返回输出时无结构的网格数据.

source: Set the parameters of the clip function.
translation: 设定剪辑函数的参数 。

source: Select whether to compute normals.
translation: 选择是否计算正常 。

source: Select whether to compute scalars.
translation: 选择是否计算分级 。

source: The Generic Stream Tracer filter generates streamlines in a vector field from a collection of seed points. The vector field used is selected from the Vectors menu, so the input data set is required to have point-centered vectors. The Seed portion of the interface allows you to select whether the seed points for this integration lie in a point cloud or along a line. Depending on which is selected, the appropriate 3D widget (point or line widget) is displayed along with traditional user interface controls for positioning the point cloud or line within the data set. Instructions for using the 3D widgets and the corresponding manual controls can be found in section 7.4. The Max. Propagation entry box allows you to specify the maximum length of the streamlines. From the Max. Propagation menu, you can select the units to be either Time (the time a particle would travel with steady flow) or Length (in the data set's spatial coordinates). The Init. Step Len. menu and entry specify the initial step size for integration. (For non-adaptive integrators, Runge-Kutta 2 and 4, the initial step size is used throughout the integration.) The menu allows you to specify the units. Time and Length have the same meaning as for Max. Propagation. Cell Length specifies the step length as a number of cells. The Integration Direction menu determines in which direction(s) the stream trace will be generated: FORWARD, BACKWARD, or BOTH. The Integrator Type section of the interface determines which calculation to use for integration: Runge-Kutta 2, Runge-Kutta 4, or Runge-Kutta 4-5. If Runge-Kutta 4-5 is selected, controls are displayed for specifying the minimum and maximum step length and the maximum error. The controls for specifying Min. Step Len. and Max. Step Len. are the same as those for Init. Step Len. The Runge-Kutta 4-5 integrator tries to choose the step size so that the estimated error is less than the value of the Maximum Error entry. If the integration takes more than Max. Steps to complete, if the speed goes below Term. Speed, if Max. Propagation is reached, or if a boundary of the input data set is crossed, integration terminates. This filter operates on any type of data set, provided it has point-centered vectors. The output is polygonal data containing polylines.
translation: 通用流跟踪过滤器从种子点集合中生成向量字段的精简。 所使用的矢量字段是从矢量菜单中选择的,因此输入数据集需要有以点为中心的矢量. 界面的种子部分允许您选择此集成的种子点是位于点云还是沿线. 根据所选位置,将显示适当的3D部件(点或线部件)以及传统的用户界面控制,以便在数据集内定位点云或线条。 关于使用3D部件和相应的手动控制的说明,可见7.4节. 马克斯 传播条目框允许您指定精简的最大长度。 从最大。 传播菜单,您可以选择时间(一个粒子在稳定流中旅行的时间)或长度(在数据集的空间坐标中)的单位。 印记 Step Len. 菜单和条目指定集成的初始步骤大小. (对于非适应性整流器,Runge-Kutta 2和4,整个集成过程中都使用初始步骤大小. ) 菜单允许您指定单位 。 时间和长度的意义与马克思相同. 宣说. 单元格长度指定步骤长度为若干单元格。 集成方向菜单将决定溪流跟踪的生成方向:FORWARD,BackWARD,或HOW. 界面的集成器类型部分决定了用于集成的计算:Runge-Kutta 2,Runge-Kutta 4,或Runge-Kutta 4-5. 如果选择了 Runge-Kutta 4-5,则显示用于指定最小和最大步长以及最大错误的控件. 用于指定 Min 、 Step Len 和 Max 的控件与 Init 的控件相同。 步连. Runge-Kutta 4-5集成器试图选择步骤大小,以便估计错误小于最大错误条目的值. 如果整合需要超过马克思. 如果速度低于期数, 步骤完成 。 速度,如果马克思。 传播被达到,或者如果输入数据集的边界被跨越,整合即告终止. 这个过滤器在任何类型的数据集上运行,前提是它具有以点为中心的向量. 输出为包含多线的多边形数据.

source: Specify the maximum streamline length.
translation: 指定最大精简长度。

source: This property controls how the filter works to generate vector cell data. You can choose to compute the gradient of the input scalars, or extract the vorticity of the computed vector gradient tensor. By default, the filter will take the gradient of the input scalar data.
translation: 此属性控制过滤器如何生成矢量单元格数据 。 您可以选择计算输入刻度的梯度, 或者提取计算出的矢量梯度的涡度 。 默认情况下,过滤器将采用输入的scalar数据的梯度.

source: If off, only Vectors and Normals will be transformed. If on, all three-component data arrays (considered as 3D vectors) will be transformed. All other arrays won't be flipped and will only be copied.
translation: 如果关闭,只有矢量和正常会改变。 如果打开,所有三元数据阵列(被认为是3D向量)都会被转换. 所有其他阵列不会被翻转,只会被复制.

source: The Warp By Scalar filter translates the points of the input dataset along a vector by a distance determined by the specified scalars. This filter operates on polygonal, curvilinear, and unstructured grid datasets containing single-component scalar arrays. Because it only changes the positions of the points, the output dataset type is the same as that of the input. Any scalars in the input dataset are copied to the output, so the data can be colored by them.
translation: Worp By Scalar 过滤器将输入数据集的点沿矢量平移为由指定的scalars决定的距离. 这种滤波器在多边形、曲面线和无结构的网格数据集上运行,其中包含单元件的scalar阵列. 由于它只改变点的位置,输出数据集类型与输入类型相同. 输入数据集中的任何刻度都被复制到输出中,因此数据可以被它们涂色.

source: This property specifies whether to clip the dataset, and if so, it also specifies the parameters of the plane with which to clip.
translation: 此属性指定是否剪辑数据集,如果是的话,它也指定要剪辑的平面参数.

source: This filter generates surface normals at the points of the input polygonal dataset to provide smooth shading of the dataset. The resulting dataset is also polygonal. The filter works by calculating a normal vector for each polygon in the dataset and then averaging the normals at the shared points.
translation: 这个过滤器在输入多边形数据集的点上生成表面常态,以提供数据集的光滑阴影. 由此产生的数据集也是多边形的. 滤波器通过计算数据集中每个多边形的正常矢量,然后在共享点平均正常.

source: Produce surface point normals.
translation: 产生表面点正常。

source: The value of this property defines a feature edge. If the surface normal between two adjacent triangles is at least as large as this Feature Angle, a feature edge exists. If Splitting is on, points are duplicated along these feature edges. (See the Splitting property.)
translation: 此属性的值定义了特征边缘 。 如果两个相邻三角之间表面的正常程度至少与这个地物角一样大,则存在一个地物边缘. 如果拆分开始,则在这些特征边缘上重复点数. (见分地产.

source: This property controls the splitting of sharp edges. If sharp edges are split (property value = 1), then points are duplicated along these edges, and separate normals are computed for both sets of points to give crisp (rendered) surface definition.
translation: 这种财产控制着尖锐边缘的分裂. 如果锐边被分割(财产值=1),则沿这些边缘重复点数,为两组点数分别计算正常点数,以给出简洁的(递归的)表面定义.

source: The value of this property controls whether consistent polygon ordering is enforced. Generally the normals for a data set should either all point inward or all point outward. If the value of this property is 1, then this filter will reorder the points of cells that whose normal vectors are oriented the opposite direction from the rest of those in the data set.
translation: 此属性的值控制是否执行一致的多边形命令 。 一般说来,一个数据集的正常情况要么是所有向内点,要么是所有向外点。 如果此属性的值是 1, 那么此过滤器会重新排序正常向量方向与数据集中其他向量方向相反的单元格的点 。

source: If the value of this property is 1, this filter will reverse the normal direction (and reorder the points accordingly) for all polygons in the data set; this changes front-facing polygons to back-facing ones, and vice versa. You might want to do this if your viewing position will be inside the data set instead of outside of it.
translation: 如果此属性的值为 1, 此过滤器将反转数据集中所有多边形的正常方向( 并相应重排各点) ; 这将前向多边形改为后向多边形, 而反之亦然 。 如果您的查看位置将位于数据集内部而不是数据集之外,您可能想要这样做 。

source: The Align Image Origins filter treats input images as parts of a whole, and sets the same origin. Each block's extent is set relative to that origin.
translation: 对齐图像起源过滤器将输入图像作为整体的一部分处理,并设置相同的来源. 每个区块的范围是相对于该来源设定的.

source: Make image origins consistent.
translation: 使图像来源一致。

source: Facet Reader
translation: 面部阅读器

source: Generate PolyData representing the external surface of a HTG.
translation: 生成代表 HTG 外部表面的 PolyData 。

source: The Ribbon filter creates ribbons from the lines in the input data set. This filter is useful for visualizing streamlines. Both the input and output of this filter are polygonal data. The input data set must also have at least one point-centered vector array.
translation: 丝带滤波器从输入数据集中的线条中产生丝带. 此过滤器可用于可视化精简 。 此过滤器的输入和输出都是多边形数据. 输入数据集还必须至少有一个以点为中心的矢量阵列.

source: This filter generates ribbon surface from lines. It is useful for displaying streamlines.
translation: 这个过滤器从线条产生丝带表面. 它有助于展示精简。

source: The value of this property indicates the name of the input vector array used by this filter. If the UseDefaultNormal property is set to 0, the normal vectors for the ribbons come from the specified vector array.
translation: 此属性的值表示此过滤器使用的输入矢量阵列的名称 。 如果使用Default Normal属性设定为0,则丝带的正常矢量来自指定的矢量阵列.

source: The value of this property specifies the offset angle (in degrees) of the ribbon from the line normal.
translation: 此属性的值指定了丝带与线条正常的相抵角( 度) 。

source: The Arrow source appends a cylinder to a cone to form a 3D arrow. The length of the whole arrow is 1.0 unit. The output of the Arrow source is polygonal data. This polygonal data will not contain normals, so rendering of the arrow will be performed using flat shading. The appearance of the arrow can be improved without significantly increasing the resolution of the tip and shaft by generating normals. (Use Normals Generation filter).
translation: 箭头源将一个圆筒附加到圆锥上,形成3D箭头. 全箭的长度为1.0单位. 箭头源的输出为多边形数据. 这种多边形数据将不包含常态,因此箭头的渲染将使用平面阴影进行. 箭头的外观可以在不通过生成常态而显著提高尖端和轴的分辨率的情况下加以改进. (使用正常生成过滤器).

source: This property indicates the number of divisions around the cone. The higher this number, the closer the polygonal approximation will come to representing a cone, and the more polygons it will contain.
translation: 这个地产表明圆锥周围的分数. 这个数字越高,多边形近似会越接近于代表一个圆锥,它所包含的多边形就越多.

source: Set the orientation vector of the cone. The vector does not have to be normalized. The cone will point in the direction specified.
translation: 设定圆锥的方向矢量 。 矢量不必正常化. 圆锥将指向指定的方向.

source: The Box source can be used to add a box to the 3D scene. The output of the Box source is polygonal data containing both normals and texture coordinates.
translation: Box源可以用于在3D场景中添加一个框. Box源的输出是包含正常和纹理坐标的多边形数据.

source: The Cylinder source can be used to add a polygonal cylinder to the 3D scene. The output of the Cylinder source is polygonal data containing both normals and texture coordinates.
translation: 圆柱形源可用于在3D场景中添加一个多边形圆柱形. 圆柱源的输出是包含正常和纹理坐标的多边形数据.

source: This property indicates the number of divisions around the cylinder. The higher this number, the closer the polygonal approximation will come to representing a cylinder, and the more polygons it will contain.
translation: 这个属性表示圆柱周围的分割数. 这个数字越高,多边形近似会越接近于代表一个圆柱,而它所包含的多边形也就越多.

source: The normal of the plane containing the ellipse.
translation: 包含椭圆的平面的正常.

source: This source uses input parameters, most notably a string descriptor, to generate a vtkHyperTreeGrid instance representing the corresponding a tree-based AMR grid with arbitrary rectilinear geometry and either binary or ternary subdivision.
translation: 此源使用输入参数,最显著的是字符串描述符,生成一个 vtkHyperTreeGrid 实例,代表对应的基于树的AMR 网格,带有任意的直线几何,或二进制或三进制子分区.

source: Hyper tree grid representing a tree-based AMR data set
translation: 代表基于树的AMR数据集的超树格

source: The Plane source can be used to add a polygonal parallelogram to the 3D scene. Unlike the sphere, cone, and cylinder sources, the parallelogram is exactly represented at the lowest resolution, but higher resolutions may be desired if this plane is to be used as an input to a filter. The output of the Plane source is polygonal data.
translation: Plane源可用于在3D场景中添加一个多边形平行图. 与球体,圆锥和圆柱源不同的是,平行图完全代表了最低分辨率,但如果要将这个平面用作滤波器的输入,则可能会需要更高的分辨率. Plane源的输出是多边形数据.

source: Create a parallelogram from an origin and two points
translation: 从一个来源和两个点创建平行图

source: The value of this property represents the number of divisions between Start Theta and End Theta around the sphere. (See the Start Theta and End Theta properties.) The theta divisions are similar to longitude lines on the earth. The higher the resolution, the closer the approximation will come to a sphere, and the more polygons there will be.
translation: 此属性的值代表球体周围Start Theta和End Theta之间的分数. (见Start Theta和end Theta属性. ) 塞塔师与地球上的经纬线类似. 分辨率越高,近似值就越接近一个球体,多边形就越多.

source: The value of this property represents the number of divisions between Start Phi and End Phi on the sphere. (See the Start Phi and End Phi properties.) The phi divisions are similar to latitude lines on the earth.
translation: 此属性的价值代表了球体上Start Phi和End Phi之间的分割次数. (参见Start Phi和End Phi属性. 滇支系与地球上的纬线类似.

source: The three values in this property are used to scale the superquadric in X, Y, and Z. The surface normals will be computed correctly even with anisotropic scaling.
translation: 此属性中的三个值用于缩放X,Y,和Z的超方格. 即使采用异位缩放,也会正确计算表面正常情况。

source: The value of this property represents the number of divisions in the theta (longitudinal) direction. This value will be rounded to the nearest multiple of 8.
translation: 此属性的值代表着该地(纵向)方向的分区数. 此值将四舍五入到最接近的 8 倍数 。

source: The value of this property represents the number of divisions in the phi (latitudinal) direction. This number will be rounded to the nearest multiple of 4.
translation: 此属性值代表phi(纬度)方向的分割数. 此数字将四舍五入到最近的倍数 4。

source: If the value of the Toroidal property is 1, this value represents the thickness of the superquadric as a value between 0 and 1. A value close to 0 leads to a thin object with a large hole, and a value near 1 leads to a thick object with a very small hole. Changing the thickness does not change the outer radius of the superquadric.
translation: 如果Toridal属性值为1,则该值代表超方格的厚度为0到1之间的值. 接近0的值会导致一个有大孔的薄物体,靠近1的值会导致一个有非常小孔的厚物体. 改变厚度不会改变超方体的外半径.

source: This property defines the roundness of the superquadric in the theta (longitudinal) direction. A value of 0 represents a rectangular shape, a value of 1 represents a circular shape, and values greater than 1 produce higher order shapes.
translation: 这个属性定义了超方格在theta(纵向)方向上的圆度. 0的值代表长方形,1的值代表圆形,大于1的值产生更高的顺序形状.

source: This property defines the roundness in the phi (latitudinal) direction. A value of 0 represents a rectangular shape, a value of 1 represents a circular shape, and values greater than 1 produce higher order shapes.
translation: 此属性定义了phi(纬度)方向的圆度. 0的值代表长方形,1的值代表圆形,大于1的值产生更高的顺序形状.

source: The value of this property represents the isotropic size of the superquadric. Note that both the Size and Thickness properties control coefficients of superquadric generation, so the value of this property may not exactly describe the size of the superquadric.
translation: 此属性的值代表着超方体的异构大小. 注意超方块生成的大小属性和厚度属性均控制系数,因此此属性的值可能不能准确描述超方块的大小.

source: If the value of this property is 1, an average of neighborhood scalar values will be used as the output scalar value for each output point. If its value is 0, only subsampling will be performed, and the original scalar values at the points will be retained.
translation: 如果此属性的值为 1, 则每个输出点的输出刻度值将使用邻里平均刻度值 。 如果它的值是0,则只进行子采样,并保留各点的原始scalar值.

source: The Wavelet source can be used to create a uniform rectilinear grid in up to three dimensions with values varying according to the following periodic function. OS = M * G * (XM * sin(XF * x) + YM * sin(YF * y) + ZM * cos(ZF * z)) OS is the output scalar; M represents the maximum value; G represents the Gaussian; XM, YM, and ZM are the X, Y, and Z magnitude values; and XF, YF, and ZF are the X, Y, and Z frequency values. If a two-dimensional extent is specified, the resulting image will be displayed. If a three-dimensional extent is used, then the bounding box of the volume will be displayed.
translation: Vavelet源可用于在最多三个维度内创建一个统一的直线网格,其值因以下周期函数而异. OS = M * G * (XM * sin(XF * x) + YM + sin(YF * y) + ZM * cos(ZF * z)) OS是输出的分数; M 代表最大值; G 代表高斯人; XM, YM 和 ZM 代表X, Y, 和 Z 级值; XF, YF 和 Z F 是 X, Y, 和 Z 频率值. 如果指定了二维范围,则将显示由此产生的图像。 如果使用三维范围,则将显示该卷的边框。

source: The six values in this property indicate the X, Y, and Z extent of the output data. The first two values represent the minimum and maximum X indices, the next two are the minimum and maximum Y indices, and the last two are the minimum and maximum Z indices.
translation: 此属性中的6个值表示输出数据的X,Y,和Z范围. 前两个值代表最小和最大X指数,后两个是最小和最大Y指数,后两个是最小和最大Z指数.

source: Turn on/off the generation of elliptical splats. If normal warping is on, then the input normals affect the distribution of the splat. This boolean is used in combination with the Eccentricity ivar.
translation: 开启/关闭椭圆板的生成. 如果正常的warping是开着的,那么输入的正常会影响plat板的分布. 这种布林与Ecentrity ivar结合使用.

source: Control the shape of elliptical splatting. Eccentricity is the ratio of the major axis (aligned along normal) to the minor (axes) aligned along other two axes. So Eccentricity gt 1 creates needles with the long axis in the direction of the normal; Eccentricity lt 1 creates pancakes perpendicular to the normal vector.
translation: 控制椭圆花板的形状. 偏心率是主轴(按常态排列)与依其他两轴排列的小轴(轴)的比例. 因此,Ecentrity gt 1在正常方向上用长轴产生针头;Ecentrity lt 1在正常矢量上产生煎饼垂直.

source: The Mandelbrot source can be used to add a uniform rectilinear grid with scalar values derived from the Mandelbrot set to the 3D scene. The equation used is z = z^2 + C (where z and C are complex, and C is a constant). The scalar values in the grid are the number of iterations of the equation it takes for the magnitude of the value to become greater than 2. In the equation, the initial value of z is 0. By default, the real component of C is mapped onto the X axis; the imaginary component of C is mapped onto the Y axis; and the imaginary component of the initial value is mapped onto the Z axis. If a two-dimensional extent is specified, the resulting image will be displayed. If a three-dimensional extent is used, then the bounding box of the volume will be displayed. The output of the Mandelbrot source is image (uniform rectilinear) data.
translation: 曼德尔布罗特源可以用于添加一个统一的直线网格,其刻度值来自曼德尔布罗特设定到3D场景. 使用的方程为z=z^2 + C(其中z和C复杂,C为常数). 网格中的刻度值是值大于2的方程的重迭数. 在方程中,z的初始值为0. 默认情况下,C的真构件被映射到X轴上;C的假构件被映射到Y轴上;初始值的假构件被映射到Z轴上. 如果指定了二维范围,则将显示由此产生的图像。 如果使用三维范围,则将显示该卷的边框。 曼德尔布罗特源的输出是图像(uniform regtilinear)数据.

source: Representation (unsigned char) of the Mandlebrot set in up to 3 dimensions
translation: 最多3维的Mandlebrot代表(未签名字符)

source: Create a Mandelbrot representation
translation: 创建曼德尔布罗特代表

source: The three values in this property allow you to specify the projection from the 4D space used by the Mandelbrot set to the axes of the 3D volume. By default, the real component of C (represented by 0) is mapped to the X axis; the imaginary component of C (represented by 1) is mapped to the Y axis; and the real component of X, the initial value (represented by 2) is mapped to the Z axis. The imaginary component of X is represented by 3. All values entered must be between 0 and 3, inclusive.
translation: 此属性中的三个值允许您指定从曼德尔布罗特集使用的4D空间到3D卷轴的投影. 默认情况下,C(以0为代表)的实际成分被映射到X轴上;C(以1为代表)的想象成分被映射到Y轴上;X(以2为代表)的实际成分被映射到Z轴上. X的假想成分为3个. 所有输入的值必须在 0 到 3 之间, 包括 。

source: Origin CX
translation: 来源 CX

source: Extract a subset (line or plane) from a structured-grid starting with a seed point. The filter supports cases where the structured grid is split up into multiple blocks (across multiple ranks). It also handles cases were the ijk origin for each the blocks is not aligned.
translation: 从种子点开始的结构网格中提取子集(线或平面). 过滤器支持结构化网格被分割成多个块(跨多个等级)的情况. 如果每个区块的ijk来源没有对齐,它也会处理案件。

source: Cells are deflated by 0.5 * Tolerance before the cell overlaps are computed. Deflating is done by translating each cell's faces and edges, in their normal direction, by a vector of norm Tolerance.
translation: * 在计算单元格重叠之前可容差性。 减充是通过将每个单元格的面部和边缘按正常方向平移,通过规范容差的载体来完成的.

source: If turned on, then non-linear cells quantities will be computed by taking their linear approximate, i.e. ignoring their faces' curvature in a second output array named \"Quality (Linear Approx)\".
translation: 如果打开,则非线性单元格数量将通过其线性近似来计算,即在名为\“质量(Linear approx)\的第二个输出阵列中忽略其面部的曲率”。

source: This filter computes metrics on the boundary faces of a volumetric mesh. The metrics that can be computed on the boundary faces of the mesh and are: (1) Distance from cell center to face center (2) Distance from cell center to face's plane (3) Angle of face's plane normal and cell center to face center vector
translation: 这个滤波器计算一个卷状网格的边界面上的度量。 可在网格的边界面上计算出的尺度是:(1) 从单元格中心到面中心之间的距离(2) 从单元格中心到面平面的距离(3) 面部平面的角平面正常和单元格中心对面中心向量

source: This property indicates whether the distance from cell center to face's plane will be computed.
translation: 这个属性表示是否计算出从单元格中心到面部平面的距离.

source: Angle Face Normal And Cell Center To Face Center Vector
translation: 角面正常和单元格中心到面面中心矢量

source: This property indicates whether the angle of face's plane normal and cell center to face center vector will be computed.
translation: 这个属性表示面平面正常和单元格中心对面中心向量的角度是否会被计算.

source: Base for all XML-based file-series writers.
translation: 所有基于 XML 的文件序列作者的基础 。

source: The Random Attributes filter creates random attributes including scalars and vectors. These attributes can be generated as point data or cell data. The generation of each component is normalized between a user-specified minimum and maximum value. This filter provides that capability to specify the data type of the attributes and the range for each of the components. Note that in the case of an input HTG, only cell random attribute generation is available.
translation: 随机属性过滤器创建随机属性,包括scalars和向量. 这些属性可以作为点数据或单元格数据生成. 每个组件的生成在用户指定的最低值和最高值之间实现正常化。 这个过滤器提供了指定每个组件属性的数据类型和范围的能力. 注意在输入HTG的情况下,只有单元格随机属性生成.

source: Decide whether to activate volume preservation which greatly reduces errors in triangle normal direction. If off, volume preservation is disabled and if AttributeErrorMetric is active, these errors can be large.
translation: 决定是否激活可大大减少三角形正常方向错误的音量保存 。 如果关闭, 音量保存被禁用, 如果 AtprojectErrorMetric 活动, 这些错误可能很大 。

source: Scalars Attribute
translation: 刻度属性

source: Scaling weight contribution of the scalar attribute. This value is used to weight the contribution of the scalar attribute towards the error metric.
translation: 放大刻度属性的重量贡献 。 此值用于加权scalar属性对错误度量表的贡献.

source: Normals Weight
translation: 正常重量

source: Scaling weight contribution of the normal attribute. This value is used to weight the contribution of the normal attribute towards the error metric.
translation: 放大正常属性的重量贡献 。 此值用于加权正常属性对错误度量表的贡献.

source: Generates a region ids cell array. A region is defined as a collection of connected cells with a maximal angle between their normals. Grouping cells into regions is similar to Connectivity filter, while the Normal criteria is similar to Feature Edges computation. Note: Duplicated points may create unexpected regions. It is advised to run a Clean filter to remove them. Warning: FeatureEdgesRegionIds is not implemented for Distributed environment.
translation: 生成区域 IDs 单元格数组。 一个区域被定义为一个连接的单元格的集合,在它们的正常之间有一个最大角度. 将单元格分组到区域类似于连通性过滤器,而正常标准类似于地物边缘计算. 注:重复的点可能会产生出乎意料的区域. 建议运行清洁过滤器以移除它们。 警告: 分布环境未执行 。

source: The maximum angle between two adjacent cell of a same face.
translation: 同一面部的两个相邻单元格之间的最大角.

source: Set whether feature IDs should be generated. Some GDAL primitives (e.g., a polygon with a hole in its interior) are represented by multiple VTK cells. If you wish to identify the primitive responsible for a VTK cell, turn this on. It is off by default for backwards compatibility. The array of feature IDs will be the active cell-data pedigree IDs.
translation: 设定是否应该生成特性标识 。 一些GDAL原始体(如内部有孔的多边形)由多个VTK单元格代表. 如果您想要识别一个 VTK 单元格的原始责任, 请打开它 。 默认为反向兼容而关闭 。 特征ID的阵列将是活动单元格数据 pedigree ID.

source: When WriteAllTimeSteps is turned ON, the writer writes every available timestep to file. Otherwise, only the current timestep is written.
translation: 当 Write AllTimeSteps 打开时, 作者会写出所有可用的文件时间步 。 否则,只写当前时间步 。

source: Represent the information property for transient data.
translation: 代表瞬间数据的信息属性。

source: Writer to write polygonal data in Wavefront OBJ format. Written files contain the geometry including lines, triangles and polygons. Normals and texture coordinates on points are also written if they exist. This version is used when running in parallel. It gathers data to first node and saves one file.
translation: 用Wavefront OBJ格式写入多边形数据的 Writer. 书面文件包含几何形状,包括线条,三角形和多边形. 点上的正常和纹理坐标如果存在,也会被写入. 此版本在平行运行时使用. 它收集到第一个节点的数据并保存一个文件.

source: Duplicate Points For Face Texture
translation: 面部纹理复制点

source: Face Blocks Id Info
translation: 面部块 Id 信息

source: Face Block Field Info
translation: 面部块字段信息

source: Face Block Fields
translation: 面部块字段

source: Face Sets Id Info
translation: 面部设置 Id 信息

source: Face Set Field Info
translation: 面部设置字段信息

source: Face Set Fields
translation: 面部设置字段

source: Select the face sets fields / arrays to read.
translation: 选择要读取的面部设置字段/ 数组 。

source: Face Set Selectors
translation: 面部设置选择器

source: Specify the face sets selectors for the data assembly chosen using **Assembly** to choose the blocks to write from the input dataset.
translation: 指定使用 **Assembly ** 选择从输入数据集中写入的块时选择的数据组的面部集选择器。

source: If input is transformed, e.g. through clipping, new element blocks may be created. This flag can be used to indicate whether to preserve the original ids from blocks or not.
translation: 如果输入被转换,例如通过剪辑,可以创建新的元素块. 这个旗帜可以用来表示是否从块中保留原始的ID.

source: When checked, the writer will write quality assurance and information records, if available.
translation: 检查时,如果有质量保证和资料记录,写作者将撰写。

source: Writer to write polygonal data in Stanford University PLY format. The data can be written in either binary (little or big endian) or ASCII representation. As for PointData and CellData, vtkPLYWriter cannot handle normals or vectors. It only handles RGB PointData and CellData. This version is used when running in parallel. It gathers data to first node and saves one file.
translation: 用斯坦福大学PLY格式写多边形数据的作家. 数据可以用二进制(小的或大的endian)或ASCII代表书写. 至于PointData和CellData,vtkPLYWriter无法处理正常或向量. 它只处理RGB PointData和CellData. 此版本在平行运行时使用. 它收集到第一个节点的数据并保存一个文件.

source: If rasterizing 3D geometry, setting this option will export all cube axes actors as vector graphics.
translation: 如果光栅化3D几何, 设置此选项将导出所有立方轴演员为矢量图形 。
